name: Unpriced Information Relay
primary_objective: Maximize net cash-account compound growth; test positive paired net log-growth advantage against BOTH dividend-reinvested QQQ and SPY. No invented strategy backtest, expected return or Sharpe is claimed.

canonical_account.cash: Actual available cash/T-bill return convention after fund/account fees
canonical_account.benchmark_dates: Identical first funded observation, endpoint and dividend convention

mechanism: Unexpected operating information at a listed source changes a receiver's economics through a previously documented directional cash-flow exposure; trade only the modeled impact not yet absorbed by receiver prices. Existing source/receiver price momentum is a confound and direct baseline.

novel_contribution.proposal: Event-specific economically oriented residual text surprise transported through pre-existing signed edges, corrected for response age and observed pricing; one-event-per-receiver first-arrival ledger with invalidation and shared shock exposure caps.
novel_contribution.priority: No global originality, conservation theorem, structural causal identification or positive net edge is asserted.
novel_contribution.ledger: Accounting for conditional predictions and risk. Returns and information do not physically conserve.
exclusions: Portfolio allocator as source of alpha

universe.delistings: Retain historical members and delisting/terminal outcomes
universe.default_status: All limits are preregistered hypotheses, not optimized values

horizon.holding_until: Earliest original event horizon, invalidation, receiver disclosure, or exhausted net edge. First fill never restarts the event horizon.
horizon.session_age: Completed exchange sessions after publication plus progress within current eligible session divided by that session scheduled minutes; first partial session denominator is its remaining scheduled minutes. After-close releases begin age sessions at next open. Original twentieth eligible session close is age20 even on half days; H is fitted on exactly this clock.

events.timestamped_secondary_feed: Used with primary source evidence and actual provider receipt
events.classification: Frozen event rulebook, evidence spans, immutable classifier/model identity; ambiguous mixed events abstain
events.dedup: Issuer permanent ID + accession/document identity + near-duplicate text/time cluster, with every article retained but one economic shock

features.availability: available_at = max(provider_receipt, ingestion, inference_completed); relations known_at < first_publication
features.encoder: Annual/fold frozen historical checkpoint trained solely on prior-available documents; if dated weights unavailable, chronological TF-IDF/ridge baseline; current checkpoint permitted only prospectively
features.residual_text: v = z - E_hat[z|pre_event_numeric_controls], all transforms/PCA/vocabulary fit only on training
features.source_label: 20-session source factor-residual log return from publication reference, divided by pre-event sqrt(20)*std(last 60 pre-event daily residual returns)

demand.exposure: Share of receiver supplier revenue from source customer

interruption.exposure: Share of receiver customer cost attributable to source supplier

features.orientation_warning: Source-price-to-operating meaning must agree with disclosure quantities/duration and frozen class rule; ambiguous effects on source margin/market power abstain.

initial_model_defaults.dimension_reduction: Training-only PCA for dense encoder; chronological TF-IDF limited to 1000 terms for baseline
initial_model_defaults.standardization: Training-only means/scales; dimensionless penalties applied to standardized predictor coordinates
initial_model_defaults.sparse_class_policy: Pool timing curve only; abstain if receiver transmission cannot be estimated

features.graph: One-hop pre-event documented customer/supplier relation; competitor sign inferred from industry alone forbidden; unknown weight/sign abstains
features.sigma_horizon: sqrt(20)*std(last 60 daily factor-residual log returns preceding public event)
features.observed_absorption: Receiver cumulative log return from last completed minute mark before first public release to allowed current mark, minus pre-event rolling market/industry beta prediction. Mark includes actual receipt delay, overnight and completed pre-entry prices. Known splits and dividends adjusted consistently with factor-residual outcomes.
features.factor_residualizer: 252 completed pre-event daily observations, intercept + SPY total-return proxy + historical receiver-industry ETF total-return proxy; coefficients frozen per event; synchronized minute/overnight benchmark returns over receiver's exact intervals. No contemporaneous refit.
features.attention: Optional diagnostic only: prior daily Wikipedia/coverage vintages, missing coverage unknown; not canonical admission feature

signal.receiver_training: Fit b_c>=0 minimizing sum((receiver_20_session_residual_log_return/sigma_horizon - b_c*a*s*q_OOF)^2) + ridge_penalty*b_c^2 on mature training events. Entire source predictor pipeline evaluated out of fold. Negative economically expected class fit becomes b=0 and abstention.

units.costs: Simple-return fraction, compared to transformed directional simple-return forecast.

signal.delay_curve: Training-only monotone response fraction H(age) on knots [0,1,2,5,10,20], bounded [0,1], H(20)=1; linear interpolation; response-monotonicity is a testable hypothesis
signal.overlapping_events: One independent active event per receiver. Duplicate cluster uses largest absolute conditional forecast, opposing cluster signs abstain. Second independent event retires prior forecast and exits next window; block until 20 sessions after latest publication. No proportional allocation of differently originated cumulative price responses.
signal.uncertainty: Connected-event/date-cluster full-pipeline resampling uncertainty in conditional mean; ranking threshold is heuristic and does not imply post-selection coverage.
signal.entry_equation: d*(exp(u - d*1.645*SE_mean_forecast)-1) - expected_round_trip_cost > 0.002. This transforms a heuristic uncertainty-adjusted log forecast to directional simple-return units; no post-ranking confidence coverage is claimed.
signal.forecast_interpretation: mu and u are factor-residual log impacts. exp(u)-1 is a conditional relative-price effect, not absolute unhedged stock-return prediction. Admission is an incremental-alpha-versus-cost screen; unhedged market/sector losses remain and benchmark outperformance must be measured from actual net account NAV.

entry.canonical: Positive signed bounded remaining forecasts only; eligible at D 18:30, refreshed absorption/risk at D+1 09:44:59, orders 09:45-10:00
entry.orders: Bounded marketable limits/participation using quotes available at submission; exact limit boundary and cancellation reason logged.
entry.limit_rule: Buy at at most 5 bps above received best ask, capped by positive lower-bound edge budget; short research sell symmetrically 5 bps below bid. Only executable observed liquidity counts; no guaranteed fill.
entry.staleness: Quote age <=2 seconds at order/refresh; older mark blocks entry.
entry.partial_fills: Persist actual filled quantity; remaining expires at 10:00; no synthetic full-position completion.

rules: Material receiver-specific disclosure retires inherited forecast
Signed remaining forecast net of expected exit cost <=0
exit.routine_window: Next eligible 09:45-10:00 window; price at actual obtainable quote and size, no threshold-price fiction
exit.horizon_liquidation: For age-20 horizon, predeclared closing-window liquidation at or before endpoint using prior scheduled event clock; no prediction persists past endpoint.
exit.emergency: Corporate action, borrow recall, or predeclared account risk policy permits obtainable immediate liquidation; loss caps do not guarantee against gaps
exit.duplicates: Never reset event or holding clock

portfolio.weights: Normalize positive net-edge/annualized-variance scores to stock budget 0.95; apply stock/sector/shock caps with iterative redistribution only among qualifying eligible names; unallocated amount stays cash. Scale down only if ex-ante volatility exceeds target.
portfolio.covariance: 252 prior completed sessions, shrink covariance, previous-close snapshot hash

short_variant.status: Separate diagnostic research account; never mix its performance with canonical account
requirements: Observed dated borrow availability and price
Cash collateral and short proceeds separation

costs.eta_status: Uncalibrated stress hypothesis; calibrate prospectively without changing frozen holdout
costs.round_trip: Expected entry + expected exit cost and carrying costs as relevant
costs.no_double_count: Use simulated executable price concession OR matching spread/impact proxy component, not both for the same concession
costs.data_compute: Dollar cash expenses charged to NAV at payment dates; amortized diagnostics shown separately

timeline.pre_entry_absorption_refresh: Completed marks and received quotes through D+1 09:44:59 only
timeline.late_document: Wait next formation; never backdate availability
timeline.training: Five-year initial fit, expanding annual frozen updates; label endpoint < refit cutoff; purge/embargo 20 sessions at fold boundaries
timeline.weights_rule: No encoder/prompt/model upgrades within frozen evaluation; revisions restart challenger rather than silently overwrite incumbent

prior_art.title: The Inefficient Pricing of News
prior_art.scope: Residual text surprise prior, not evidence for UIR

prior_art.title: Economic Links and Predictable Returns
prior_art.scope: Customer momentum is established prior art

prior_art.title: Supply Chain Propagation of Textual Signals: LLM Embeddings and Cross-Sectional Return Predictability
prior_art.scope: June 2026 annual-report embedding + graph prior; abstract inspected, full methods unavailable

prior_art.title: Next-Day Return Prediction with Directional Supply Chain Exposure
prior_art.scope: Directional-denominator and nonmonotonic-response prior; small panel, not proven strategy

prior_art.title: Nonsynchronous Trading and Lead-Lag Bias in Supply Chain Equity Pairs
prior_art.scope: Sampling-clock confound; US-only synchronized marks reduce but do not eliminate stale-price artifacts

validation.primary_endpoint: Annualized paired net log NAV growth difference versus QQQ AND SPY total return, same funded periods.
baselines: Same-feature small regression conditioning on source/receiver pre-entry returns
Residual-news one-hop routing with no absorption
negative_controls: Event sign permutation within source/date blocks
validation.claims_gate: Prespecified simultaneous 95% lower bounds on net log-growth advantage positive against BOTH indexes in untouched holdout. Monthly/event dependence-preserving resampling; root family protocol governs joint five-strategy claims. Strong statistical significance still does not prove permanence.

forward_minimum.status: Initial unoptimized evidence gate; not sufficient proof or deployment authorization

secondary_metrics: Net CAGR and net terminal wealth
Compound excess return versus each benchmark
validation.residual_momentum_failure: If a same-feature price-only control or pre-entry residual-return matching reproduces/absorbs the benefit, classify the mechanism as momentum/reversal rather than new information diffusion.

dependencies: Timestamped archived issuer/news document vintages and actual first receipt
Directional customer/supplier exposure vintages with known_at dates
Permanent security IDs, historical universe and delistings
kill_conditions: Required historical vintages unavailable: retrospective test infeasible
Sign orientation inconsistent with operating quantities/source economics
No incremental benefit versus simple routing/price controls
Fails paired growth objective versus either benchmark

worked_synthetic_example.label: Invented arithmetic only; not a backtest

demand.u_interpretation: 1.9% forecast residual log impact; not an absolute stock-return forecast or actual profit.

interruption.interpretation: Harm to receiver customer; short diagnostic only, canonical long-only abstains
